subject: Quick follow: discovery notes + one clarifying question
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Tillard <sam.tillard@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow: discovery notes + one clarifying question

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for carving time today. Quick recap so we have alignment and one follow-up question:

Summary from today's discovery (15 min):
- Main goal: reduce inference cost for Finova's nightly batch scoring while improving tail latency for interactive fraud-review UI.
- Primary constraint: cannot transmit PII to third-party clouds; on-prem or VPC required for pilot.
- Success metric: 30% token-cost reduction on daily batch runs while keeping median latency < 120ms for 1k concurrent sessions.
- Stakeholders: you (platform), Lena (fraud ops), infra/security TBD.

Open question: for the pilot, do you need model outputs persisted in Finova's DB (for audit) or is streaming-only acceptable and logs captured in your SIEM? That affects the evidence we need to show for data retention and will change our recommended rollout.

Next steps I proposed:
1) I send a 1-pager with our deployment options and a very short implementation checklist (attached).
2) If fit, schedule a 30–45 minute technical alignment with Lena + infra to scope the VPC/on-prem connector.
3) Provide a ballpark for a 6-week pilot (infra + engineering estimate).

If you can just answer that single question (persist vs streaming-only) I’ll tailor the pilot notes and the checklist.

Sharing the one-pager now (attached). If you'd prefer a short call instead, I can send two windows for next week.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0164

Attachment: redwood-onepager.pdf (1 page, PDF)

Hi Sam —

Bumping in case my earlier note got buried. The single detail about whether Finova needs model outputs persisted (DB storage) vs streaming-only will change the recommended evidence and timeline for an on-prem/VPC pilot.

If you're still exploring priorities, a quick reply with either "persist" or "stream" is enough and I’ll proceed accordingly.

If it’s easier, I can share two calendar options for a quick 20-min alignment with Lena and infra.

Thanks — appreciate it.
Irene

From: Sam Tillard <sam.tillard@finova.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 May 2028 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow: discovery notes + one clarifying question

Hi Irene — sorry for the delayed reply, been heads-down prepping a board package.

Short answer: we need persisted outputs for audit trails. Fraud ops needs the final model score stored alongside transaction IDs for 90 days.

Also, heads up — timeline changed on our end. The priority window moved from June to late July because our infra team is out for several sprints in June.

Can you share a ballpark for a pilot cost and whether Redwood can support the VPC-only option (no cross-cloud egress) for a limited pilot? If you can send that before next Wed (24th), I’ll review with Lena and loop infra.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Tillard
Platform Lead, Finova
sam.tillard@finova.com | +1 617-555-0122

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Tillard <sam.tillard@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lena Morse <lena.morse@finova.com>
Date: Sun, 20 May 2028 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow: discovery notes + one clarifying question

Sam — great, thanks for the clarity and for the timing update. Persisted outputs for 90 days is straightforward and we can scope that into a pilot.

Next steps (I’ll take these actions today):
- I’ll send a concise pilot estimate and a VPC-only implementation checklist by EOD Monday (24th).
- Propose a short technical sync: Tue 30 May 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 31 May 14:00–14:30 PT. If both conflict with your shifted timeline, let me know two windows in late July and we’ll lock one.
- I’ll include requirements for the retention/audit evidence (logs, sample retention policy) so security can sign off faster.

If that plan looks fine I’ll draft the HubSpot deal notes and attach the estimate there so Lena can see the breakdown.

Quick ask: do you prefer the estimate as a short PDF + line-item table or a spreadsheet? I can do either.

Thanks again — appreciate you getting back.
Irene
